nom: La Roche-Posay Effaclar Micro-Exfoliating Astringent Toner for Oily Skin

avis.texte: I did notice it somewhat minimizes the appearance of my pores however it was irritating. I wouldn't recommend if you have sensitive skin. Don't think i'd buy again mostly for the price it's at.
I have been using this product for about a year, I have minimal breakouts and acne scars are noticeably lighter. Product does not overly dry out the skin.

I've been looking for products to help with my oily skin and after reading some reviews, I thought why not give it a go. There's nothing amazing about this product. I didn't really notice any difference in my skin or the oiliness. I, personally, wouldn't buy this product for this price point.
Coming from someone whose had their face frozen a few times: this product is now a staple in my facial routine. This stuff works so well without burning or drying out my face.

This product broke my face out more than anything. It left my face feeling oily. I have sensetive skin and was told/ did my research on how this product was supposed to be good for sesetive skin, but that was not the case for me.
I liked this it didnt make me oily after and my skin felt smooth and supple. Also it lasts a while so great for the wallet
I have oily/acne prone skin with large pores and honestly after a few uses, my skin appears smoother and my pores look smaller. I will continue to incorporate this into my routine.

avis.titre: I really like this product and will buy again
avis.texte: I bought this product before in London and it worked very well. I mean I dont have any complaints and my skin never got bad. I tottally recommend and will be buying again
every time i put this on my face, lot of dirts come off and this is the brand i have been looking for!
This is the best toner i have ever tried. I have sensitive skin and toner does not affect my sensitive skin as other toners have.
My husband uses this face wash and he loves it. He had acne when he was a teenager but not anymore and he only uses this and his skin looks very smooth. He uses it 2x a day

avis.titre: Not sure how I feel about it

This is the toner I keep going back to. It's really the best. It helps keep my skin clean without breaking me out.
This product worked absolute wonders on my skin! It cleared up any texture I had and removed tough blackheads on my nose after only two uses. Great product and very worth it!
I like to use it after cleansing my face it leaves skin with a super nice texture you see a super fast change in your skin

avis.titre: Love it makes my pores almost disappear, love it!
avis.texte: Love it, makes my pore almost disappear, love it! I will definitely be buying this forever lol.
Easy to use and effective toner for managing oily skin and managing the "glow" that oils can make on your face. This makes me feel clean

My favorite toner. I'm so glad it's easily available in the US. I used to have this stuff sent to me from a friend in England. It tones the skin without drying it or irritation and didn't break me out. The only issue is, the last few drop won't come out no matter how you tip the bottle. But it's that good that I try to get the last few drops out of every bottle I've owned.
Cleans really good without drying, I've been using it for few years now and like it a lot.
I use this amazing toner morning and night and helps me to reduce the size of my pores Also I'm in love that I am amazed with the result, it makes my skin look fresh with an amazing natural glow.

avis.titre: Effaclar Astringent Toner for Oily Skin
avis.texte: This is great for my combination skin. I use it a few days per week.

I purchased this astringent because I have visible pores on my chin. I use it morning and night and can see a slight difference in the visibility of my pores. It tightens my skin without drying it out. I haven't used it very long, but will continue and believe it will reduce the size of my pores or at least the visibility.
I absolutely loved using this product not only did it make my skin shine with a natural glow it was very refreshing.

I have been using for a few months this product. I wash my face with a cleanser and then use this product and then use the effeclar sebo controler face cream. I honestly didnt see any improvement in my pores (as it says in the product) or in my skin in general. It does help clean the makeup that sometimes the makeup remover didnt.
I love how it doesn't dry out my face and how my face feels after I use it.
I love this product. I feel that this product nurtures and balances my face skin after cleaning it and makes it ready for other treatments.
I really like this product! I noticed a difference in my skin right away. It made my skin smoother in texture and color/appearance

I had never used toner before, so I didn't know what to expect. My skin is oily and very sensitive, and prone to breakouts and redness. This didn't seem to aggravate those problems. The breakouts haven't stopped, but they do seem to be getting a little less. Same for the redness. My skin seems to be less oily as well. It is supposed to make your pores less visible, but I really haven't noticed a big difference. The scent is not overwhelming, which is a good thing for anything going on my face. All in all, I give it a thumbs up!

I really enjoyed this toner!! Toner has always been a hit or miss product because they either don't really do anything or they break me out.. however this was different!! My skin started clearing up after using it and I have now incorporated it into my daily routine!! Not much in the way of cons, however I will say I also started using the Pixi glow tonic and I feel it worked just as well— so they're pretty similar in my opinion!

For starters I've never heard of this brand before and although I'm into skincare I usually take the more natural approach. But this product is definitely going to become a staple. This toner is not harsh and has a light scent. I've used this product without washing my face and then I used it in conjunction with washing my face and that was enough to convince me. Just to throw out there, my skin is sensitive but I'm not prone to breakouts and I have combination skin ( wearing mask has made my skin more oily than usual).

I have an oily forehead that can't get rid of the shine no matter what. I've been using this lately in hopes that it'll help. I haven't seen a difference in how oily my skin is. However, I do have to wear a face shield so that might have an affect. The smell is amazing. Very nice and pleasant. It makes me want to keep using it. Hopefully I see a change soon.

I received the La Roche-Posay Effaclear toner for oily skin complimentary from Influenster and was really excited about it. I had been wanting to try this brand out. I can't say that I have really noticed any visible changes with my skin since starting with this, but also, my skin has been going through it the last few weeks. I would say that this product is a little on the pricier side but it should last for a little while depending on how often you use it! I definitely will keep using this to see if it will help my skin in the future, and look forward to trying other products from this brand! Thanks Influenster and La Roche-Posay!
Well I use this product after the make up wipe remover￼ and oh boy what it takes away to leave my skin smooth and clean and it's totally shows how well it cleans it￼

avis.titre: So far so good but don't see much changes.
avis.texte: I have combination skin. Been using this every other night for the past 3 weeks after washing my face. Has a mild cooling effect and gets off the excess gunk that you may miss during washing your face. I'm not exactly sure if there's any distinct change/improvement to my skin because it's winter time where I live (I'm less prone to breaking out during this time). I don't see much change in my pores, but only time will tell once I get out more once weather warms up.
I have been using this a couple days, I like that it is not oily. It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed after use.

This is my first time using this product and I've been using this for a couple days now. The smell from the toner is a fresh, beach scent, which I really like! I did notice some changes to my sensitive skin, where some parts where a little red from trying out this new product. However, I think my skin adjusted to this product and it does even out the oils on my skin.

tighten pores without dehydration/stripping of skin, made sure to get the stubborn makeup out my pores, but i only used it directly on my pores because it irritated my already existing breakouts, would definitely recommend if you're looking for something to minimize the appearance of your pores, if you have dry skin i recommend to use good hydrating moisturizer

I didn't know what to expect with this toner. I was pleasantly surprised after just one week. My skin is softer, my pores smaller and cleaner. My skin has not been as flakey in the winter months. Glad I was sent a full size so I will be able to enjoy for quite some time.

Very refreshing, and has a cooling affect when applied. Pores have shrunk and face is less oily. Even the next morning the face is still not oily, which past toners have burnt my skin and still left skin feeling sticky. Gentle around eye area.

avis.titre: Good but watch out sensitive skin
avis.texte: Overall, I really like this toner. I use after cleansing and it absorbs quickly - I felt my skin/pore tighten within minutes. It is somewhat harsh on moderately sensitive skin, but it definitely delivers on removing oil. I've started to alternate using this toner with my regular one (morning/evening) and I like the results. Overall a very good product (maybe a bit overpriced for those with moderately sensitive skin) - would definitely recommend.

So I've been using this product for a couple of weeks and I'm not the biggest fan. It has alcohol in it which is drying for my skin. I prefer toners that aren't so harsh. I think if they replaced the alcohol it could be a great product.
I've been using this for a few days now, and I've already seen some improvement in pore size and skin texture. No new break outs while using it either. Hoping for even better progress with longer use
It's amazing. It leaves my face so clean, fresh and free of make up. Price is totally worth it
This is a game changer! It smooths my skin and my pores are getting smaller. It's hydrating yet leaves it glowy. I use at night but gentle to use morning and night.
this product has done a really good job at taking off any extra makeup and oils at the end of the day. it's also helped to dry up a few pimples that i had. im really impressed with this so far!

avis.titre: this is my first time using this product
avis.texte: i just received this product today, i did use it for the first time when i received it and it definitely did do something for me. my skin isn't oily right now, and my pores are minimized, (not completely gone), however it does smell mainly like alcohol, which isn't the best thing. but it's not too big of a bother! i will continue to use this in my skin care routine.

I am so glad I got to try this product. At first I was confused by it being a moisturizer because the consistency is more like a toner but this product worked great as a moisturizer and left my skin feeling soft and hydrated. I also have very sensitive skin and this still worked great for me. I'm very glad I got to try it because i've never seen or used a product like this before!

This toner feels great. Not drying but not oily either. It's the perfect medium. I have combo skin, not oily skin, so I feel as though this wasn't necessarily a perfect match for me, but it was good for those oily days. Would recommend more for those with oily skin.

i love this product so much. it have lots of ache and breakouts but this helped so much. the price is not to high and i would definitely buy this product again. I would 200% recommend to others.

Good one , use it to pair with La Rochy posay gel cleaners, I have oily skin and open pores and its help to control both of my problems, oil is in control and pore looking little shrink, wellwill buy again .to see more positive results.

I've been a user of a department store brand toner for over 40 years, and it worked well. But, I found as I entered my 60's, my skin was becoming dryer ( I've had oily skin, without many breakouts, all my life. Upside? No wrinkles). This particular toner didn't help anymore. I started using La Roche-Posay products last year...micellar warer, various cleansers..and liked them. Decided to give this toner a try. In a word..wonderful! It's lightweight, non-drying. Makes my skin feel clean, and that I've gotten rid of every last trace of cleanser. It has a water-like feel to it, which is what I love about it. I've tried other brands' "gentle" toners. All of them left a film on my face. This one does not. My only complaint is that it doesn't come in a larger size. I go through a bottle a month! Like I mentioned, I was a dedicated customer of another brand for over 40 years. Not anymore. La Roche-Posay is my new "go-to" brand for skin care.

Love this toner. Got it as a present from my dad and it's expensive so I didn't buy it again but i loved using it when I had it. Cleaned my face and refreshed it for makeup application or just a clean face for the day
Excellent for oily skin. Helps not only with refining pores but also with mild exfoliation which in turn helps with making your skin look clearer.
Is a great healing face problems! Is a must have tonic for some@ of your days in the month!

I am in my early 20's and have sensitive and acne prone skin. I purchased this toner about a week ago and so far it seems to be doing an excellent job at removing traces of my makeup after I cleanse my skin. There is a little bit of stinging and discomfort after applying my serum and moisturizer but nothing serious. The tingling/stinging sensation subsides in 10 minutes usually. I have noticed my skin being softer with a more refined texture. I have yet to see the long term benefits of using this toner but thus far it has been excellent!

I like to switch out my toners every few months or so. I like this toner because it doesn't leave my face sticky and keeps my face feeling hydrated. My skin is pretty oily in the t zone and acne-prone and so far I feel the toner hasn't made anything worse. I think the bottle probably be bigger based on its price in my opinion, but the quality is what's most important so i give it a 4.

I am in my early 50's i still have (had) the occasional break out AND getting wrinkles to boot. how unfair is that right ? Anyway, I had a hard time finding something for older skin and acne that wouldn't leave my skin dry and irritated. I have a box FULL of failed attempts. Until now .. I first used this product without the toner as i was concerned a toner would be too drying. After that product worked i decided to try this with the toner in it. I got just a small bottle only to fine that I LOVED IT. I have sensitive skin and this product does not burn or irritate like some toners do and leaves my skin smooth clean and soft. I did try washing my face and then followed up with this toner/cleanser and i was amazed at amount of dirt my previous routine left behind and this toner picked up. Clean non drying with a mild toner ... i hope to never be without this product.

This is a great non-drying toner. Absolutely no stining sensation. I'm suprised by how much more dirt, make-up etc.. comes of skin using this toner after cleansing. Although I still have acne, the texture of my skin is better- less dry,rough, patchy areas, little smoother and definetly LESS IRRITATED. Very happy with purchase. I would reccommend and will purchase again.

This is probably my favorite toner for my skin. I have tried a lot in the past and this is gentle, soothing, and definitely helps with pores. This doesn't sting like harsh alcohol toners. It is perfect for my oily, sensitive, acne-prone skin.

I love this toner. I am in early 20s. I was one of those people think toner does nothing special but just added step of the skin regiment... until I met this one. I refused to use it thinking I had a dry skin with acne prone. Then I realized in fact I have oily skin that was dehydrated. I use this every night to unclog any dirt or makeup residue. I only use it for the night since I don't wanna over dry my skin. works perfectly. I have less visible blackheads on my nose. extremely happy with this!
This stuff exceeded my expectations. It doesn't burn like so many others do and doesn't dry out your face either.

I use this before my Effaclar Duo to reduce the stinging/tingling feeling it can give my skin without it. My dermatologist referred me to the Effaclar line and I don't know what I would do without it! This toner is gentle on my skin. Easy to use and effective. I love it!
I purchased this product first time in a pharmacy in Europe. It was highly recommended by a pharmacist. I have been using this more than three years.

avis.titre: Amazing product for reducing pore size
avis.texte: I started using this product when i noticed i had large pores on my nose and around my nose under my eyes. After using this product, your skin instantly feels tighter and more refreshed. It might sting a little after using it, but it's completely tollerable. After using this product for three or four weeks, i've noticed that my pores are dramatically minimized. I also noticed that it helped clear away some of my blackheads on my nose, but most of them are still there.
The toner does everything it says it can do. Especially for my new unbalanced skin of a menopausal woman. This toner is perfect. Thanks La Roche Posay!

This product does not sting or burn my face. It feels like it woks so well that I use no other acne product afterwards, so my routine has become quicker. I really like that this toner cleans whatever makeup that is still on my face that my cleanser did not clean away.
It is a really good product which any one can use especially with oily and acne prone skin people

I like this toner a lot because it is not harsh. It does not smell and although I do have sensitive skin I believe it would work well on any skin type due to it just being a light toner with a somewhat moisturizing effect. Great price too, that is one of the reasons I stick with this line...the price is right and I order when free shipping is available.

avis.titre: Far Better than Cosmetic Counter Brands
avis.texte: I have been a repeat customer of this product and have tried just about every brand of toner that is on the market and this is just wonderful not over drying for sensitive skin, great for cystic acne no strong smell and not expensive it lasts about 6 months when used everyday! Don't hesitate to try it's truly a great product. Does not make your face all red perfect for using before applying makeup or after cleansing your face
